facts.fact: The ministry states that implementation of the national broadband plan (PNHD) continues, with PNHD-2 launched for the uncovered areas over two years from 2024.
The ministry reports that at end March 2024 PNHD1 had covered 10,620 of the 10,740 localities targeted for 2023 with 4G, 98.88 per cent.
